name: Ampere threadblock, warp, and instruction tile hierarchy
summary: Choose compatible threadblock, warp, and MMA instruction shapes so an SM80 Tensor Core GEMM tile decomposes exactly across warps and hardware MMA operations.

strategy.intent: Build a reusable CTA tile from warp-level and instruction-level Tensor Core tiles.
strategy.mechanism: Instantiate DefaultMma with explicit threadblock, warp, and instruction shapes and derive global/shared iterators and the multistage MMA policy.
strategy.expected_benefit: Makes reuse, warp parallelism, instruction throughput, and resource use jointly tunable.
tradeoffs: Large threadblock tiles increase shared-memory and register demand.
Small tiles can reduce reuse and Tensor Core utilization.

parameters.name: threadblock_shape
parameters.description: CTA-level M, N, and K tile.

parameters.name: warp_shape
parameters.description: Per-warp M, N, and K tile.

constraints.rationale: Warps must exactly partition the CTA tile.
MMA instructions must exactly partition each warp tile.
Every pipeline stage stores A and B tiles in shared memory.
This record targets the Ampere TensorOp multistage specialization.

references.evidence: The TensorOp specialization accepts threadblock, warp, instruction, and stage parameters and constructs iterators plus a multistage MMA core.
